_README: Curated install map for /xp-scaffold-acceptance Step 2 — overrides web-search for tools where the popular package name collides with an unrelated GUI app or the wrong tap. Each entry: install_cmds (argv strings, run via shlex.split), verify_identity_cmd (a `--version`-style invocation), expected_version_pattern (Python regex matched via re.search against stdout). Add an entry only when the web-search-driven install has a documented collision; default flow stays WebSearch.
